candidate.label: B01E
candidate.why_rebuilt: The I04R fixture (private/i04-event-worker-final) predates this session's source edits and refuses to load (source_hashes mismatch in 11 files). A current-tree, emulator-only candidate was built instead. It is not a hardware candidate.

established: TRX-B2 knobs0-7 use native sound slots17-24. Extra parameters8-14 use slots46-52 and ids164-170; those extra slots must not be confused with the eight TRX controls.
A sound is saved as version 4 of the 160-byte record, and only machine-pages reads that version (machine-pages README).
mp_sound_save packs the stock slots 1-45, then the 7 extras, then slot 0; mp_sound_load restores them (mods/machine-pages/src.c, mp_sound_save/mp_sound_load).
In the booted emulator the values are readable and writable at kit + KIT_SOUND + 162*track + 20 + 2*slot; This is RAM access, not proof of native eight-TRX-control persistence.
The emulator's SD card is file-backed and flushed (emu/esdhc.py Card.flush), so card persistence is emulatable in principle.
not_established: That save -> change -> load round-trips the extras. Not demonstrated.
Whether project save/reload, copy-paste, undo, sound locks or machine switching are reachable from the emulator panel at all.

known-good_reference.what_it_does: Builds an UNPATCHED Machine from the stock image, calls MAP_INIT, SLOT_ID, PARAM_SLOT, SOUND_INIT, then SOUND_SAVE=0x4007A5A0 / SOUND_LOAD=0x4007A236 with stacked args and a 0xDEADBEE0 sentinel, and asserts a real round-trip plus that a stock saver does NOT preserve candidate slots.
known-good_reference.why_it_works: Unpatched routine bodies, correct native entries, and MAP_INIT/SOUND_INIT run first.
known-good_reference.next_step: For an eight-control TRX persistence harness, exercise slots17-24 at native save/load entries. Generic extra-slot coverage is separate. Later physical displayed-state restoration checks are linked from TASKBOARD.md.

plan_consequence: B1/B3 (sound save/load) look automatable once the harness above exists; it also gives a reusable regression for future candidates.

B2/B4/B5/B6/B7/B8/B9/B10 depend on real UI flows (project save, clipboard, undo, mutes, sound locks, machine switch, Pi detached). No emulator hook exists; assume hardware with I04R unless one is found.
B9 (persistence without the Pi) is hardware by definition for a physical claim.
limits: No Gate B case has passed; nothing here is acceptance evidence.
B01E carries the V01 diagnostic defines, so it is a test image, not a shippable build.
The emulator models the card, not a real Digitakt's storage timing or battery-backed state.
Panel gestures in this file are observations of this firmware, not a documented manual.
correction_2026_10_30: The first eight TRX-B2 controls are base knobs0-7, native sound slots17-24. Slots46-52 are extra slots; in the V01 diagnostic build they display SECS/UI/WORK/WGAP/BATCH/UGAP/FAULT, not TRX controls. Earlier extra-slot experiments do not prove the eight TRX controls round-trip.
